content: {"episode_id":"ep-05008","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered for a patient presenting with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat (R00.2), which are concerning for potential arrhythmias in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). The monitoring was required to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities in order to correlate the reported symptoms with any underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities. The clinical indication documented in the submitted records supports the medical necessity of this diagnostic service, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial on that basis."}
